'''Telos Dock module 126''' was located on [[Citadel Station]] of [[Telos IV]]. It had three major [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]]; one belonged to the [[Telos Security Force]], one belonged to the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] restoration project and the last belonged to [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Each had a receptionist and a docking administrator.

When [[Brianna]] stole the Ebon Hawk from its hangar and brought it to the Telosian Jedi Academy, the hangar that belonged to the Telos Security Force was temporarily locked down pending an investigation.
